chapters.title: Two heaps: free rooms and busy rooms

frames.caption: Two heaps: free rooms and busy rooms — O(m log m + m log n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: most_booked(n=3, meetings=[[1, 20], [2, 10], [3, 5], [4, 9], [6, 8]]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
room = heapq.heappop(free) — 0 taken from the front of free; room = 0
room = heapq.heappop(free) — 1 taken from the front of free; room = 1
heapq.heappush(busy, (end, room)) — (10, 1) pushed on the front of busy
room = heapq.heappop(free) — 2 popped off the end of free; room = 2
